resultText:
No critical ambiguities detected worth formal clarification. I asked no questions and left the spec and its checklist unchanged.

The one fact the spec assumes about the existing system — page from 1, page size 1 to 100, default 10 — matches the shared contract (`PageQueryDto`, `DEFAULT_PAGE_SIZE`, `MAX_PAGE_SIZE`).

- **Questions asked and answered**: 0
- **Spec**: `specs/003-fix-rooms-pagination/spec.md` (no sections touched)
- **Spec Quality Checklist**: 16/16 → 16/16 items passing, no items changed state
- **Extension hooks**: none; `.specify/extensions.yml` does not exist

| Category | Status | Note |
|---|---|---|
| Functional scope & behaviour | Clear | FR-001 to FR-009 give the exact slice per page; bookings are explicitly out of scope |
| Domain & data model | Clear | Room and page of rooms are defined; 12 seeded rooms with unique names |
| Interaction & UX flow | Clear | The `/rooms` page scenario and the empty page past the last one are covered |
| Non-functional quality attributes | Clear | Not applicable to a paging fix; FR-009 rules out new behaviour |
| Integration & external dependencies | Clear | No new dependencies or routes |
| Edge cases & failure handling | Clear | Past-last page, partial last page, size 1, size ≥ total, defaults and invalid input are all listed |
| Constraints & tradeoffs | Clear | Fix limited to the defect; the same defect elsewhere is recorded, not fixed |
| Terminology & consistency | Clear | "Page", "page size" and "rooms per page" are used consistently |
| Completion signals | Clear | SC-001 to SC-005 are each checkable |
| Misc / placeholders | Clear | No TODO markers or vague adjectives |

Two points are left to planning because they are about method, not behaviour:
- **Frontend change**: whether `apps/web` needs any change depends on the root-cause analysis; the spec already makes this conditional.
- **Regression test location**: which layer the test lives in is a planning choice; FR-008 fixes what it must exercise.

Suggested next command: `/speckit-plan`
